purpose: Independent pure-PTQ reference frontier for the fixed five-arm recovery experiment
reference_rule: Freeze every completed PTQ recipe before the selected recipe in the audited development prefix, including fp8 and excluding BF16. Do not select, add or remove references using heldout outcomes.
selection_source: compare_development.audit_development only; no heldout input is accepted by freeze

budget.scope: Full checkpoint encoding budget, physical and known-tied-alias deduplicated, each with its matching source denominator
budget.recovery_residual: Add the independently stored BF16 LoRA payload to each recovery point; verify rank, scope and trainable elements against the actual merge/recovery manifest.
budget.limitation: Encoding estimates are not measured dense checkpoint size, native deployment memory or latency.

comparison.pairing: Same official bank/restored/postsettle hashes, task and episode order as all five main arms
comparison.reporting: Report every frozen reference including unfavorable results; observed nondominated points are descriptive, not a noninferiority test or a global PTQ optimum.
comparison.prohibited: No heldout-driven recipe, rank, teacher-weight, training-length or checkpoint tuning.
